output.content: I was checking the logs for the latest churn model training run. The feature extraction step pulls raw values directly from the warehouse tables every time a new job starts. There is no centralized repository holding precomputed features. When the team requests a specific historical slice for backtesting, I manually query the source data and export a flat file. The latency for these manual pulls averages forty minutes per request. The validation scripts check for null values in the raw input, but they do not verify consistency across different model versions because the features are not versioned or stored in a shared location. We have been running this manual workflow for the last three months of model iterations.
output.reclassify_reason: The artifact is a descriptive report of the current operational state, including manual workflows, latency metrics, and validation gaps, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
